name: Dock
description:
Dock is a revenue enablement platform that includes::

• Collaboration: Customer workspaces that transition from sales deal room to onboarding portal, to renewal hub.

• Content: A content management system that automatically tags and organizes your content. And AI Documents that generate personalized business cases, meeting summaries, and action plans in seconds using live CRM data and call transcripts.

• Learning: An AI Enablement Agent that provides real-time answers and guidance. Courses and learning playbooks for internal training.

The result is outcomes revenue leaders actually care about: faster deal cycles, higher win rates, and smoother customer onboarding.

Learn more at dock.us

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dock to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dock to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.dock.us/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dock MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dock lists 21 MCP tools, including dock-add-asset-tags, dock-add-page-template-to-workspaces, dock-agent-search, dock-archive-assets, dock-archive-workspaces, dock-ask-agent, dock-change-asset-tags, dock-confirm-action, dock-create-playbook, dock-create-workspace, dock-duplicate-workspace, and dock-edit-workspace-contacts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dock?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dock in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Dock requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dock is developed by Dock. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
